description: The ubiquitin protein structure (PDB: 1UBQ) is loaded in PyMOL. Ubiquitin is a small 76-residue protein with a characteristic beta-grasp fold. Your task is to measure the distance between the alpha carbon (CA) atoms of the first residue (MET at position 1) and the last residue (GLY at position 76) in chain A. Create a distance measurement object called 'dist_NC' that is visible in the viewport, displaying the distance in Angstroms as a dashed line with a numerical label between these two atoms. You will need to use PyMOL's atom selection syntax to identify the correct atoms and the appropriate measurement command.
